marketShareCoverage.denominator: All monitored USD Moment sales: offers, listings and legacy; Packs excluded.
metadataSources: Flow TopShot MomentMinted and NFT.ResourceDestroyed events plus current contract Play/Set metadata
limitations: Metadata is resolved at collection time, not historical sale time.
Missing Set/player metadata is retained as Unattributed, included in the denominator.
Set IDs distinguish the same set name across series; players use official names with current player-directory alias resolution where available.

activityCoverage.attribution: Unique observed transfer endpoints, marketplace participant addresses, and single transaction authorizers for locks, listing removal/cleanup, NFT destruction and pack reveal/open requests. Authorizers are signers, not proven owners; transactions with zero or multiple authorizers remain unattributed unless other events identify participants.
limitations: Covers the listed TopShot, PackNFT, TopShotLocking, NFTStorefrontV2, OffersV2 and legacy TopShotMarketV3 events; it is not an exhaustive audit of every TopShot-related contract or every on-chain action.
Transfers include gifts, mint deliveries and withdrawals; a gift cannot be distinguished reliably from an off-platform paid transfer.
Mint, reveal and open completion events without participant addresses do not independently identify users; administrative signers are not inferred as collectors.
Listing removal may be public cleanup of an expired or ghost listing; its signer is not necessarily the seller.
Metadata/series/set administration, contract/account setup, permission changes, calls without monitored events, and off-chain activity are excluded.
Only the listed known system addresses are excluded; addresses are not unique people and undiscovered service addresses may remain.
